Hero_Desc_Lazy:
An unfortunate elf who is an employee of Monatium City's IT Management Unit,
but gets called and dragged away for all kinds of work because she once showed how capable an employee she was.
Album_Lazy1: Layze is a staff member of the IT department in the elven city of Monatium. Her chronically fatigued appearance is quite notable.
Album_Lazy2: Layze seems to have many duties beyond IT management. Whenever someone visits the management office, she's always called away somewhere else...
Album_Lazy3: Besides machine repairs, Layze is skilled at code debugging and cable management. She doesn't take much pride in these tasks, perhaps because they're not very visible.
Album_Lazy4: Amelia and Elena highly value Layze's ability to handle miscellaneous tasks. However, that's all—they show no intention of promoting her. They say as someone who's good at everything, she's just in the right place where she is now.
Album_Lazy5: Layze tinkers with various projects during her limited leisure times. Because of her talent for odd jobs, which is seen in the diverse products she crafts. On the other hand, she claims she would have to make tools for everyone if she were found out, thus she never crafts things linked to work.
Album_Lazy6: Though Layze appears to be a work-focused elf on the surface, she has many different hobbies. From playing musical instruments, writing, drawing to sculpting and origami, she has proven her decent skills across various recreational activities.
Album_Lazy7: The elves in the field quietly love Layze. They say it's because thanks to her, they've regained some work-life balance and can actually take vacations. But that doesn't mean she actually helps with the work or anything.
Food_ChefNote_Lazy_Hate1: Layze says eating it is such a hassle, since there are crumbs everywhere every time she does.
Food_ChefNote_Lazy_Hate2: She doesn't seem to like it, saying the drink makes her mind race when she's working.
Food_ChefNote_Lazy_Like1: She liked it, calling it a highly efficient food that makes for a quick meal.
Food_ChefNote_Lazy_Like2: There's no way Layze will refuse this beverage. It's a must-have for any diligent worker.
Food_ChefNote_Lazy_Like3: She loved the thick broth, saying it perfectly suited her palate.
Food_ChefNote_Lazy_Like4: After a hard day's work, she says taking a bite of this food will end the day on a high note.
Food_ChefNote_Lazy_Like5: She inhaled it, claiming it keeps her mind sharp while she's working.
Food_ChefNote_Lazy_Like6: Although it tastes great as soon as it comes out, since it gets soggy as time goes by, she wants to improve the taste.
Food_ChefNote_Lazy_Like7: Although eating it in large quantities may not be easy for her, she says it helps maintain energy when her work is challenging.
Food_ChefNote_Lazy_Like8: She calls the food very nutritious, saying she'd definitely recommend to her teammates.
Food_ChefNote_Lazy_Like9: Looking at the elf-shaped candy, she felt nostalgic and proud.

LoveLetter_Lazy: Oh, hello, Master. This is Layze.This is the first time I've written a letter to you.I'd rather greet you face to face, but you always seem so busy whenever I see you.I tend to get dragged into things, even when I don't want to, but you always seem to be actively looking for things to do.Oh, I didn't mean that in a negative way! I just wanted to express that I can truly feel the impact you've had in Elias, and I'm grateful for all that you do.Thank you once again. Next time, let's meet face to face.
LoveCall_Lazy:
Hello, Master. This is Layze.
...What? Is there a job that needs doing?
Well, I usually contact you only for that, so it is understandable.

This call is not about work.
I simply thought I should thank you at least once.
You always look after every worker with such care.
As I travel from job to job, I can feel that consideration everywhere.

So, um. Yes. Thank you very much, Master.
...This kind of call is not a burden, is it? You must be busy, and I worry I called without a good reason. This is a little embarrassing.
I will hang up now.
